full_details: Garnish brought twenty-three rolls, copied in six days. You read every voice, and you read Peter flat on purpose. Pope took the Nurse at her first speech. He had dandled worse. He wanted the child and a cushion. He did the weaning, the earthquake, and the fall backward, with a napkin on his head. The room stopped for as long as a paternoster. Heminges wept into the reckoning-book and struck James Burbage on the back. Phillips heard Mab again and smiled at the fire. Richard Burbage did not speak until the end. Then he said the lover is all haste, and that he is seven-and-twenty. You told him to play it at a run. Nick marked his roll and asked nothing. Kemp has nine-and-twenty lines, a fan, and half a song. You asked him to keep Saturday supper free. What you have for him is not in this play. You were still on you. The afternoon's Shrew went on at the Theatre. You were at home, and not in it. You wrote no new page.
one_sentence: You read the lovers at Holywell, Pope took the Nurse, and you came home for the afternoon.
title: Read the lovers, and stayed home from the Shrew
